settings.eyebrow: Center for Balanced Living · Assessment Services
settings.heading: Psychological Evaluation Services
settings.subheading: Comprehensive evaluations for children, adolescents, and adults. Diagnostic clarity that informs care, school supports, and clinical decision-making.

settings.heading: Assessment as a clinical act.
settings.body: Psychological evaluation at Center for Balanced Living is not a checkbox exercise. It is a clinical process, attentive to the whole person, grounded in current psychometric standards, and oriented toward actionable findings. Every evaluation concludes with a written report and a feedback session where results are explained clearly and completely.

settings.heading: Psychodiagnostic Evaluation
settings.description: Comprehensive clinical interview, behavioral observation, and standardized testing to clarify diagnosis for adults and adolescents presenting with mood, anxiety, trauma, or complex presentations.

settings.heading: Psychoeducational Evaluation
settings.description: Cognitive, academic, and processing assessments for children and adolescents. Results inform IEPs, 504 plans, academic accommodations, and school-based supports.

settings.heading: ADHD and Executive Function Assessment
settings.description: Differentiated assessment of attention, working memory, processing speed, and executive function. For children, adolescents, and adults seeking diagnostic clarity.

settings.heading: Forensic and Specialized Evaluation
settings.description: Available by referral for disability documentation, custody proceedings, and specialized clinical purposes. Contact us to discuss your specific referral question.

settings.question: How long does an evaluation take?
settings.answer: Most evaluations require 6–10 hours of testing spread across multiple sessions, plus a feedback appointment. The full process typically takes 3–6 weeks from intake to report.

settings.question: Is the evaluation covered by insurance?
settings.answer: Coverage varies by plan and evaluation type. We can provide a superbill for out-of-network reimbursement. Contact us to discuss your specific insurance situation before scheduling.

settings.question: What does the evaluation process involve?
settings.answer: Every evaluation includes an intake interview, standardized testing, behavioral observation, collateral review (school records, prior reports), a written report, and a feedback session.

settings.question: Do you evaluate adults as well as children?
settings.answer: Yes. We conduct evaluations for children, adolescents, and adults. Adult evaluations focus on diagnostic clarification, ADHD, and conditions that may not have been identified in childhood.

settings.heading: Ready to schedule an evaluation?
settings.subheading: Start with a brief consultation. We'll help you determine which evaluation best fits the referral question.
